title: Arizer Solo II MAX Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Solo II MAX Herbal Vaporizer

The Solo II, aka Solo 2, got the MAX treatment
A great vaporizer gets even better

Immerse yourself in the most recent innovations of Arizer’s portable dry herb vaporizer technology. They’ve taken the popular Solo II and given it some incredible upgrades including Advanced Rapid Heating Ceramic Technology, upgraded Custom Session Settings, Automatic Display & Control Inversion, Dark Mode functionality, and USB-C charging. Plus Use While Charging for non-stop action.

Everything you like about the Solo 2 with extra features and upgrades

ADVANCED RAPID-HEATING CERAMIC TECHNOLOGY
Ready to Use in 30 Seconds!

UPGRADED CUSTOM SESSION SETTINGS
Complete Control at your fingertips

AUTOMATIC DISPLAY AND CONTROLS INVERSION
Read the display and use the controls in any position

DARK MODE FOR DISCREET USE
A simplified display for low light environments

ISOLATED AIR PATH
Fresh Air, Smooth & Tasty Vapor

CAREFULLY SOURCED COMPONENTS
High Quality Parts & Accessories

Includes
Solo 2 MAX Multi-Purpose Micro Heater
USB-C Charger and Cable
1* Glass Aroma Tube Frosted
1* Glass Aroma Tube 110MM
2* PVC Travel Tubes
2* Silicone Stem Caps
1* Stainless Steel Stirring Tool
4* Stainless Steel Filter Screens

BONUS ITEMS:
Package 1: 4 Piece Premium Grinder, 4 Screens, 2 Cleaning Sticks
Package 2: Aroma Tube, 4 Screens, 2 Cleaning Sticks, Cleaning Brush
Screens are optional, recommended for finely ground plant material

Add an Arizer Soft Case for only $17

Features:
Digital controls
The Original Glass Pod System
Easy to Use & Easy to Clean
Heavy Duty Vaporizer
Ready to use in 30 Seconds
Improved Air Flow
Great vapor production
Adjustable shutoff timer
USB-C Charging
up to 3 hour+ battery life at lower temp settings
2 year parts and labor warranty

Warranty Information
